requirements.description: Where collaborative session modes are enabled, the system may let multiple viewers share one terminal session without allowing a follower to steal the leader's input or resize authority.
requirements.title: Collaborative Session Modes

validation.notes: Planned capability; validation will cover leader/follower authority and shared output when implementation begins.

requirements.description: Where workspace presets are enabled, the system may persist and restore named pane layouts, commands, and appearance settings across browser sessions.
requirements.title: Persisted Workspace Presets

validation.notes: Planned capability; validation will cover named preset persistence and faithful layout restoration when implementation begins.
